title: Vulnerabilites & AI with Nate Berkopec
description:
Nate Berkopec returns to Remote Ruby joining Chris, Andrew, and David for a deep conversation about the latest wave of Ruby security vulnerabilities, AI-powered cybersecurity, and the rapidly changing role of software engineers. Nate shares his firsthand experience investigating a serious Ruby regex vulnerability, explains why developers need to take a more proactive approach to security, and challenges traditional development practices in an AI-driven world. From autonomous coding agents and dramatically faster development workflows to rethinking unit tests and code reviews, this episode explores why the future of programming may be less about writing code and more about building systems that deliver results. Hit download now!
